Townhouse for Sale in Bliss 2, Arabian Ranches 3

Provident Real Estate is proud to present this beautifully designed 3-bedroom + maid's townhouse in Bliss 2, Arabian Ranches 3—the newest and one of the most sought-after communities by Emaar.

Designed with a contemporary urban village concept, this home offers spacious interiors, abundant natural light, and high-quality finishes throughout. The open-plan living and dining area flows seamlessly into the private garden, creating the perfect space for both family living and entertaining.

Property Features:
3 Bedrooms
Maid's Room
Bright & Spacious Layout
Modern Open Kitchen
Private Garden
Balcony
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
Covered Parking
Premium Emaar Finishes
Community Amenities:
Resort-Style Swimming Pool
Fully Equipped Gym
Community Centre
Kids' Play Areas
Landscaped Parks
Walking & Cycling Tracks
BBQ Areas
Sports Courts
Supermarket & Retail
24/7 Gated Security

Bliss 2 offers a unique blend of contemporary architecture and family-oriented living, making it one of the most desirable addresses in Arabian Ranches 3. Ideally located with easy access to major highways, schools, shopping destinations, and Dubai's key landmarks.

Whether you're looking for your next family home or a long-term investment, this is an excellent opportunity to own in one of Dubai's fastest-growing villa communities.
